description: Established successful marketing and sales strategies including implementation of Gourmet-to-Go sales counter at local supermarket.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust background in environmental science, including experience performing site assessments and hazardous material surveys. Their transition to the Personal Chef business demonstrates strong marketing and sales acumen, with strategic insights into client relationship management and market expansion. The combination of technical skills from their Environmental Science degree and practical entrepreneurial experience highlights a proactive approach to problem-solving and customer service.
